It extends ARCH models by incorporating lagged conditional variances, allowing for more flexible modeling of variance dynamics. In the context of player consistency, lower variance implies greater stability, which is quantified via the volatility constant. The derived consistency index inversely relates to this variance, offering a scalar measure of performance steadiness. The temporal variance dynamics captured by GARCH enable GSE to model state transitions in player roles and performance levels. These models are sensitive to data quality and may fail under structural breaks or non-stationarity. The integration of GARCH with VAR or GAS enhances multi-dimensional consistency evaluation, particularly for shooting metrics. The mathematical structure supports Bayesian updating in GSI for predictive reliability assessments.
